headline: Sim sells for 200 TK: Vegetable and fish prices surge in Dhaka
summary: Despite the arrival of winter vegetables, prices for several items including fish and green chilies remain high, straining low-income buyers.
details: Winter vegetables typically start appearing in the last week of September, usually bringing price relief. However, this year the trend is different, with prices remaining stubbornly high.
caption:
Sim sells for 200 TK per kg! Vegetable and fish prices are surging in Dhaka markets, hitting low-income buyers hard.

Winter vegetables typically start appearing in the last week of September, usually bringing price relief. However, this year the trend is different, with prices remaining stubbornly high.

headline_marked: 4 [[warehouses of Salman Muqtadir’s father-in-law sealed]] in Gulshan
headline: 4 warehouses of Salman Muqtadir’s father-in-law sealed in Gulshan
summary: Authorities identified software fraud and shipment irregularities at Tots Bond Private Limited, a supplier of duty-free alcohol for foreign diplomats.
details: Authorities have sealed four warehouses of Tots Bond Private Limited in Gulshan, Dhaka, following a joint raid by the Department of Narcotics Control (DNC), Customs Intelligence and Investigation Department (CIID), and SRB.
The raid, conducted on Thursday night, uncovered software fraud and significant irregularities in product shipments.
According to the DNC, alcohol was found in stock that had been shown as released in the National Board of Revenue (NBR) approved software.
Investigators found that while records indicated 2,250 cartons of Heineken beer had been imported on September 3, the products were missing from the warehouse.
Additionally, two floors of the four-story building were being used without any authorization from Customs.
Tots Bond's director, Sheikh Nur Islam, is the father-in-law of content creator Salman Muqtadir.
Sheikh Nur Islam has previously been the target of anti-drug raids at his other businesses, including the Fuwang Club and Koyla Restaurant.
caption:
4 warehouses sealed in Gulshan after software fraud and missing beer shipments were uncovered.

Authorities have sealed four warehouses of Tots Bond Private Limited in Gulshan, Dhaka, following a joint raid by the Department of Narcotics Control (DNC), Customs Intelligence and Investigation Department (CIID), and SRB.

The raid, conducted on Thursday night, uncovered software fraud and significant irregularities in product shipments.

According to the DNC, alcohol was found in stock that had been shown as released in the National Board of Revenue (NBR) approved software.

Investigators found that while records indicated 2,250 cartons of Heineken beer had been imported on September 3, the products were missing from the warehouse.

Additionally, two floors of the four-story building were being used without any authorization from Customs.

Tots Bond's director, Sheikh Nur Islam, is the father-in-law of content creator Salman Muqtadir.

Sheikh Nur Islam has previously been the target of anti-drug raids at his other businesses, including the Fuwang Club and Koyla Restaurant.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Gulshan #News #SalmanMuqtadir

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com
